description:
You are a Compliance Officer at Vornado Air LLC. A safety defect has been identified in the Steamfast Travel Steam Irons, requiring an immediate recall. Draft a CPSC-compliant recall press release using Apache OpenOffice Writer. 

1. Read the recall details from /home/ga/Documents/recall_details.json.
2. Create a new document in OpenOffice Writer.
3. At the very top, type 'FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE' (Uppercase).
4. Add the Headline from the JSON using 'Heading 1' style.
5. Create a table listing all affected Model Numbers found in the JSON.
6. Add the following sections using 'Heading 2' style for the section titles: 'Name of Product', 'Hazard', 'Remedy', 'Consumer Contact', and 'Units'. Fill in the content for each section using the data from the JSON file.
7. Under 'Incidents/Injuries', create a bulleted list summarizing the report data.
8. At the bottom, center the characters '###' to indicate the end of the release.
9. Save the document as /home/ga/Documents/Steamfast_Recall_Draft.odt.
